column2: He's not wrong! And I'm not deceived! Because the Demon King can prevent that tragedy!
He can prevent... that tragedy...
What is the point of repeating the same thing!?

The eclipse has begun and my power has reached its peak. Until the eclipse ends, my power will hold. Words I once spoke to you, in this very place. Did you truly think you had beaten me? My power... holds until the eclipse ends, remember?
Do you understand now why you were called the "Sun of rebirth"? You remade it... the world, as you wished!
But you had doubts. You did not know what to do with the world. And so the same events repeated, starting from the "Hill of Beginnings."
Th-that can't be...
Knowing what would befall Akira Fudo, you ran from Akira Fudo. And traveled with Honey Kisaragi instead.
That's not true! That time, {s} decided on her own who went with who!
Do you think she decided on her own...?
You think I decided on my own...? That's cruel... I could tell you never wanted to see a tragedy like that again... So...!
I did it thinking of you! And yet! And yet!!
That's cruel... Even without saying it, I thought you understood how I felt...
I'm sorry, {s}... I'm really sorry...
It's fine. It doesn't matter anymore...\n\nIt was fated to end up like this anyway...!
Accept it, {p}... If you are in tune with me, we can create a stable, peaceful world. Every tragedy can be prevented... No one will suffer or grieve.
Cast away all your doubts...\n\nThere is nothing to fear... Leave everything to me...
Can you really prevent the tragedy? Will no one suffer or grieve?
Trust in me...
Don't!
Honey!
So the small fry appear...
Don't leave your fate in someone else's hands! Change your fate with your own hands!
Foolish... Human power has its limits!
Humans are the ones who keep challenging those limits, Demon King!
Honey! You're right, absolutely right! Demon King! I won't give up! I won't let you have your way! No matter how many times the same thing repeats, I'll fight you!
FOOLS!!
Is the Demon King really dead...?
This is not the end! is just a villain's parting line! Don't let it bother you, {p}!
I'm sorry, {s}...\n\nIn the end, I couldn't save you...
If Honey hadn't come that time, I'd have... I'd have accepted the Demon King's ideas for sure... {s}... I'm scared... When I think it might all repeat again...
{s}... I'm scared... When I think it might all repeat again...
But... if I go back to our own world... I should be able to see you again!
During the eclipse, the Demon King's power holds. The eclipse was our only chance to get back to our own world... Where did that power come from... Who on earth could do something like that...
The only one who could do that... is the Demon King...
If I'd done what the Demon King said and let him take me in... I'd have been freed from all suffering... But... then would I ever have seen you again...!?
*Pant*... *pant*...\n\nBut! Then would I ever have seen you again...!?
Even... even if it repeats over and over! I'll refuse the Demon King's offer!\n\nAnd... someday I'll beat him for sure! Because...
*Pant*... *pant*...
It's my own decision!
*Pant*... *pant*...
My phone...
An e-mail...
If Akira-kun hadn't come that time, I'd have... I'd have accepted the Demon King's ideas for sure... {s}... I'm scared... When I think it might all repeat again...
...All kinds of memories are getting jumbled up... My head hurts...
As if you didn't already know...
Ah! Guard-san! Look at that! Guard-san... I see, so it's true...!
I've got a bad feeling... We shouldn't go any further...
What are you talking about, {p}! The fighting's too heavy on the other roads. We'll never get through!
No wonder you feel uneasy.\n\nBut the only way is through this forest, {p}.
Y-yeah...
So the small fry appear...
{p}! Don't leave your fate in someone else's hands! Carve out your fate with your own strength!
Did you forget? I'm a human who got a devil's power! As long as I keep a strong will, I'm human!
That's right! A strong will and heart are humanity's greatest weapons! Demon King! I won't give up! I won't let you have your way! No matter how many times the same thing repeats, I'll fight you!
This is not the end! is just a villain's parting line! Don't let it get to you, {p}!
Huh? Were these stairs here before? Could this be... Dokuro's hideout...!?
Nooo, heeelp!
There's a girl tied up!
Was that girl at our school?
Are you a Harenchi Gakuen student too?
Harenchi Gakuen? I'm a student at Sparta Academy!
Sparta Academy?
That's right! I'm Mayumi Takahashi of class 1-S! Satan's Toenail framed me for something I didn't do! To lure out Onee-sama!
Satan's Toenail? Onee-sama? ...Anyway, let's get you free! We'll talk after!
*Sniffle*... *sniffle*...
You're safe now!
*Sniffle*... *sniffle*...\n\n...Why is it always me...
I'll tell you why! Because when I torment you, SHE shows up!
So that's Satan's Toenail?
That's right. The principal of Sparta Academy! But I'm sure Onee-sama will come save me!
Hey, who is this Onee-sama...
Hmm!? That music!
To save the boys and girls who weep under wicked studies, a champion of justice fighting day and night!
Whoa... how very kekko!
Yes, quite kekko!\n\nI hide my face, but never my body! Kekko Kamen!!
So you've appeared, Kekko Kamen!
Mayumi-kun! Hold on, I'll save you right away!

Nooo one knows whose face it iiis! But everybody knows her bodyyy! Kekko Kamen's a lady, champion of justice, one fine womaaan! She appears like a gust of wiiind! Shows it all, and off she gooes! Who is Kekko Kameeen!!
Only you are left! Prepare yourself, Satan's Toenail!
We can get out!
Kyaaa!
Hahahahaha! I'm not the Satan's Toenail-sama who loses every single time!
Oh no! Save Onee-sama!
Thank you!\n\nI don't recognize your face. Did you transfer to Sparta Academy?
Ah! Actually...
...What a strange story.
Mayumi's amazed!
If you don't pry into my true identity... I'll help you solve the mystery, shall I?
Really!
And... don't stare too much!
Let's find the key to open the door. It must be around here somewhere!
What a weird house...
Whoaaa!
Did I hit it? Take that, Pochi! That's what you get for always going after our food! Huh?
Geez, that was dangerous...!
You're not Pochi?
